title: Run fair comparisons
outcome: Compare trees and boosting with your linear and logistic models.

blocks.body: Question: Does complexity earn its place?
Mathematics: Learn bias and variance, resampling, generalization, and regularization through model comparisons.
Dataset: StatsBomb Open Data: events/{match_id}.json joined to match dates. For shots, use shot locations and outcomes. Split by whole match and date.
Reading: ISL chapters 5, 6, and 8. Prefer small searches with clear questions over large parameter sweeps.

blocks.title: An Introduction to Statistical Learning · Python
blocks.note: Use selected chapters and Python labs. The book PDF is free on the authors’ site.

blocks.body: Challenge: Explain why selecting a model using test scores invalidates the final test. Repair a deliberately flawed evaluation.

tasks.prompt: Train a decision tree and a boosted tree model on the same task and partitions.
